title: Quarterly Roadmap Bridge: HostAPI + Model Catalog Runway and Initiative Canvas
creator: Aisha Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Q2 Roadmap
description:
Purpose: Create a single-quarter execution plan that aligns Hosted API feature rollouts with model catalog onboarding and operational readiness. This ticket builds an "initiative canvas" and a dependency runway that the PM/Engineering/Design leads will use to (1) sequence canaries and rollouts, (2) surface capacity and SLA gating, and (3) map OKR signals to engineering milestones.

Scope: - Surface and prioritize cross-team dependencies (runtime, infra, console, QA) - Define risk bands (green/amber/red) per initiative with mitigations - Produce a two-week cadence plan with clear handoffs for canary windows, rollback criteria, and customer communication templates - Create an OKR signal map that ties business metrics (latency p50/p95, cost/unit, model quality regression delta) to release gates

Deliverables: 1) Initiative Canvas (spreadsheet + slide) with owner, risk, estimated work, and SLO gating 2) Dependency Runway (linearized list and heatmap) for all required ENG and infra work 3) Canary/Rollback Playbook tailored to Hosted API and model swaps 4) OKR Signal Map and dashboard links for automated regression alerts 5) Stakeholder sign-off notes and a handoff checklist for operations and support.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative Canvas completed with owners and risk band for each item
All cross-team dependencies documented and prioritized in the runway
Canary playbook includes rollback criteria and who executes it
OKR Signal Map defines primary/secondary metrics and dashboard links
Stakeholder sign-off recorded from Runtime, Console, and Security leads
